brief:
Israeli army chief of staff Eyal Zamir called on forces to ready themselves for rapid surprises across all fronts during an inspection of the 96th Division at the Jordanian border, Shehab Wire reported. He described the Jordan Valley as an eastern defensive wall during his visit to the unit.

The remarks come as Israeli military leadership emphasizes vigilance along multiple border sectors amid ongoing regional tensions.

title: Israeli military chief urges troops to prepare for surprises on all fronts
